How to Connect via Lovense PC App:

1. Go to Start -> Settings -> Devices -> Bluetooth in Windows
2. Turn Bluetooth On
3. Select the device starting with "LVS-" and click Pair
4. If prompted for a code, enter 0000
5. Open the Lovense Connect app — your toy should auto-connect
6. Then click "Connect via PC App" in-game
How to Connect to Lovense Mobile App:

1. On the Lovense app, go to Discover -> Game Mode
2. Enable LAN
3. Input the IP Address and Port shown
4. Hit Connect Via Mobile App

Make sure your toy and PC are on the same Wi-Fi network!
How to Find Your Handy Connection Key:

1. Go to handyfeeling.com/setup and complete setup
2. After setup, click the top-right menu button
3. Copy your Connection Key from the popup
4. Or use the Handyverse or Onboarding app — key is shown under your device
5. The key is case-sensitive (bold = uppercase, red = numbers)
6. In-game, paste the key into the Handy Settings and press Connect

Anyone with the key can control your device — keep it private!

(Your Handy Must Be on Firmware V4 or Higher)
